title: Wikimedia Commons sample ingestion
description:
Purpose: Add verifiably licensed audio from four Wikimedia Commons categories to Apricity's production library with complete, auditable provenance.

Definition of Done:
- Direct members of the electronic music, techno samples, house music, and funk carioca categories are discovered and deduplicated.
- Audio-only, rights-verified files are imported, analyzed, and immediately usable as samples.
- Every production Recording retains normalized attribution plus the Commons page revision and raw metadata/license snapshot.
- Unsupported or incomplete licenses and non-audio files are excluded and listed in a review report.
- Repeated runs are resumable and do not duplicate library records.
